sample_reviews: I ordered the Chicken Whopper with extra cheese. Let me preface my review by declaring that I find it extremely difficult to appreciate burgers that are even slightly off from being top shelf. The Indiana Chicken Whopper is one of the best burgers I have had in Bangalore. It was humble, non pretentious and delightfully wholesome. The burger made use of simple igredients instead of using jalapenos and olives that perhaps don't belong everywhere. The patty was breaded and just perfectly fried to a crisp, the inside of the patty was a very comforting blend of minced chicken and mild seasoning. The burger took me back to the legendary Burger joint at ABC Farms, Pune. Suggestion to the management: You've got a winner on your hands, please do not falter in terms of customer service, as I can see some reviews below that talk about incorrect order, etc. It would be amazing if you could increase the patty size or include it as a customisation option.

sample_reviews: Lot like crepes cafe is in a beautiful independent villa, so, totally serene environment and very tasty and unique food gets served over here. So, bookmark this place and visit soon! | We chose this place for our Christmas breakfast. Firstly this place was hard to locate as this was off the Whitefield road. An old restaurant called The Ants cafe existed here before them & their branding wasn't taken off. It's a sprawling garden mansion with garden seating & Christmas decor to match the occasion. We didn't find any crepes in the menu even though their name bore Crepe. So it was expected that they should specialise in crepe. Anyhow, we settled for common breakfast items like a masala omlette that was served with toast & a chicken sandwich that was served with fries. We also ordered a plate of potato wedges & a masala tea & hot chocolate. The idea was to pair the wedges with the omlette. But wedges came first, followed by sandwich & tea & omlette & hot chocolate the last. The serving guy looked confused & even though it was pretty empty, the wait time was high. Hope they improve as Whitefield lacks good breakfast places. | We were delighted to know that Lot Like Crepes( a place that we love) is opening a bigger place in Whitefield with an extended full day menu. And lucky for us we decided to visit on Christmas Eve for which they also had a special menu. We started off with soups: Barley(Scotch Broth) and Cream of Mushroom, both wonderful for a cold December evening. For mains we had Stuffed Chicken Ballotine and Chicken Bacon Supreme both with veggies and crispy potatoes for sides, the chicken was very well cooked and flavorful. Then came the desserts: Christmas Pudding with Brandy Butter & Sticky Date Pudding, both topped with Vanilla Ice Cream. We ended the meal with a warm pot of Camomile Tea. All in all we had a lovely evening and looking forward to more of these special menus.

sample_reviews: Ended up ordering from Lucky Singh & Co. 3 days in a row! It says a lot of the place and the food. They have a simple menu with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Their rolls have options of either lachcha paratha or butter naan as the base. We haven't tried the non-vegetarian options but the vegetarian ones have options of butter paneer, paneer tikka, achari panner, and aloo tikki. The stuffing is good, the rolls made well with a good quantity of stuffing. Now you might want to know what would be the reason for 3 rating. Over a course of three days, the rolls were not made consistent, the stuffing though generous missed the taste to the core of the "paneer". If it was based on my first order, would have rated it at 5, but eventually changed to 3. But really appreciate the effort and I am pretty sure, I am being little too cautious and over critical but if they can make a wee bit improvement to the dish's composition - 5 star is easily achievable. | Well if you feel like reviewing a place as soon as you are done with the food either it was super good or super bad. I must say being a Delhiite in Bangalore I do get to taste some absolutely great south Indian food but really have to miss the North Indian taste. I ordered a Butter Paneer Combo from Lucky Singh. It included butter Naan, Dal Makhni and Butter Paneer. The Butter Paneer is a gourmet delight. The butter Naan was not like the rubber maida naans you usually get to eat. It was a delicate tender mouthmelting piece of bread. The Dal makhni needs lot of improvement though. I felt it was bland and tasteless but still dont feel like giving them any less points because the quality of the food and the taste of butter paneer just won't let you down. Lucky Singh will definitely satiate your tastebuds. sample_reviews: The meal at Green Path was an elevating experience. The restaurant is located right outside a metro station, making it accessible. Highly recommended! | A truly amazing place to enjoy super foods in Bangalore. Most of the food is made from millets and if not then it is red rice or natural foods. The food is delicious as well as quite filling. A must visit. | A vegetarian friendly restaurant which promotes an organic lifestyle. Easily accessible restaurant by metro which is at the mantri mall Junction.
